about: Held-out Charts phrasings for description-driven discovery (agent/pl/discovery), committed BEFORE any index change. Never tune on this set: tune on the capreg corpus, dev/paraphrases.json and the description rail. It was written by the same worker who read the capability summaries, so it is held out, not sealed. It measures whether the capability reaches the model in the first request, not whether the model uses it.
